The original horse_persian, hair_mane_01 and hair_tail_01 surfaces, their skin
weights, and the published horse_walk and horse_trot joint animations are from
the 0 A.D. repository at revision 61a3b9507d974084e6badb88a0826bd89a6d5b8b.
These publicly editable COLLADA files identify Blender User as their author.
The horse asset identifies Blender 2.80.54 and a 2019-05-09 modification.
The walk identifies Blender 2.80.45 and a 2019-03-06 modification.
A more specific individual authorship is not asserted.

The derivative complete_remount.glb and native_pose_hi.png, native_pose_lo.png
and native_pose_normal.png are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported.
The original coat and hair maps retain the attribution in NOTICE.txt.
The existing independently authored saddle, bridle, reins and cart remain
separate assets. The converter is tools/art/bake_native_remount.py and checks
every upstream Git blob. It sews the original surface for the close detail
level and samples the original shoulder, wrist, hip, hock and hoof motion into
a shared texture. The saddle, rein anchors and real-distance phase follow the
existing River Gate interfaces. This study requires actual-game evaluation.
